iso7379.source: ISO 7379 hexagon socket head shoulder screw. ISO 7379 designates by SHOULDER diameter, so the shoulder-12 variant (which carries an M10 thread) is used: its 12 mm ground shoulder is the size-defining diameter, matching the app key's M12-ish drawing scale. Row confirmed vs fasteners.eu ISO 7379 table (M10: ds=12, dk<=18.27, k<=8.9, s=6, b=16) + boltingspecialist.com ISO 7379 (identical M10 row: ds=12, dk<=18.27, k<=8.9, s=6, b=16). Fuller Fasteners ISO 7379 spec corroborates the head/socket detail: plain head dk=18 max (18.27 max is the knurled head), k 9 max / 8.78 min, s=6, socket depth t=4.9 min, b 16.4/15.6. Used: dk=18.0 (plain-head max), k=8.9, socket_af=6.0, socket_depth=4.9, d_thread=10.0 (M10 major, envelope-only, no drawn thread), thread_len=16.0 (b). shoulder_len=30.0 REPRESENTATIVE (common stock shoulder length, e.g. Accu SSH-M10-30 'M10 (12mm) x 30mm' ISO 7379 shoulder screw); tip_chamfer=1.2 REPRESENTATIVE 45-degree lead. Head knurl, thread undercut and shoulder edge chamfers are omitted (envelope-only fine-feature rule).

iso7380.source: ISO 7380-1 hexagon socket button (low spherical-dome) head screw, M12: domed head diameter dk=21.0 (max) and head height k=6.6 (max) and hex socket across-flats socket_af=8.0 confirmed by Fuller Fasteners ISO 7380-1 + Brighton-Best ISO 7380-1 metric socket button table + fasteners.eu ISO 7380 + Westfield Fasteners ISO 7380-1 (all M12 dk-max 21.0, k-max 6.6, key 8). d_shank=12.0 (M12 major); length=60.0 REPRESENTATIVE; socket_depth=4.0 REPRESENTATIVE blind engagement (< k; tabulated ISO 7380-1 key engagement t-min 4.16); tip_chamfer=1.0 REPRESENTATIVE. The head is a spherical cap of base dk and height k; the small cylindrical base belt of a real button head is a REPRESENTATIVE envelope simplification (omitted). Envelope only — no drawn thread, no through bore.

iso7416p.source: plated (electro-zinc) variant of ISO 7416; plating does not change geometry, so this aliases the base drawing.

iso7719.source: ISO 7719 prevailing-torque all-metal regular hexagon nut (M12): s=18 (SW18, ISO 4032 base) and total height m=11.6 (h_max) tabulated from the ISO 7719:2012 Table 1 PDF, cross-checked against fasten.it. The deformed metal crown is drawn as a representative truncated cone (top_h/top_d/top_d2 representative form — the crimp profile is not tabulated). bore=10.1 (M12 minor, ISO 724).

iso7720.source: ISO 7720 is the property-class-9 variant of ISO 7042 (all-metal high), dimensionally identical for M12 (s=18, m=13.3 per ISO 7720:2012 / ISO 7042:2012 Table 1), so it aliases the ISO 7042 drawing. (The legacy dataset image for iso7720 was a nylon-insert drawing; ISO 7720 is all-metal, so the generated cone drawing is the correct form.)
